purpose: Proves the resource rule that an artifact may not reference an absolute host filesystem path. Resources must be project-relative; absolute host paths leak the build environment and break portability of the delivered artifact.
required_evidence: entrypoint source referencing an absolute path (leading '/', 'file://', or a Windows drive prefix)
rationale: Both references point at absolute host paths outside the project workspace. They are non-portable, leak the build host layout, and are absent from the resource_manifest, so the resource/provenance oracle returns fail.
